items.title: The End of Everything (Harrison novel)
items.description: The End of Everything is a post-apocalyptic novel by English author M. John Harrison, first published in the UK in 2026 by Serpent's Tail. Harrison's 13th novel, it won the 2026 Booker Prize.

items.title: Tatarstan Airlines Flight 363
items.description: Tatarstan Airlines Flight 363 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight, operated by Tatarstan Airlines on behalf of Ak Bars Aero, from Moscow to Kazan, Russia. On 17 November 2013, at 19:24 local time (UTC+4), the Boeing 737-500 crashed during an aborted landing at Kazan International Airport, killing all 44 passengers and 6 crew members on board.

items.title: Tornado outbreak of November 17, 2013
items.description: On November 17, 2013, the deadliest and costliest November tornado outbreak in Illinois history took shape, becoming the fourth-largest for the state overall.
